factsTableHint: Enter and load a source key to maintain its definitions and values; clear it and load to browse all sources by page only. Definition changes preview before Apply; value changes update existing facts only.
collectionFactsSaved: Contract applied atomically by the backend
collectionFactsEmpty: No source facts match the filters.
collectionFactsDefinitionInvalid: Enter a unique fact name and choose a valid kind and data type.
collectionFactsValueInvalid: The value does not match this fact's data type.
collectionFactsValueExampleDatetime: Example: 2026-08-26T15:30:00.000Z or 2026-08-26T15:30:00.000+08:00 (must include Z or an explicit offset)
collectionFactsValuesSaved: The Backend updated the fact values.
collectionFactsPreviewHint: Preview does not write to the Backend. Apply only after confirmation.
collectionFactsPreviewConfirmImpact: I confirm that deletions or semantic changes may clear fact values and affect related cursors.
collectionFactsPreviewConfirmationRequir: Confirm the deletion or semantic-change impact first.
collectionFactsOperationFailed: The Fact Table operation did not complete. Check the saved Backend connection and input.
collectionFactsBatchOperationsHint: Import opens the file picker. In Tauri, templates and exports open the system Save As dialog; a browser environment uses download fallback. Files are handled only in the current page.
collectionFactsLoadContractFirst: Load the current sourceKey contract before importing definitions.
collectionFactsReplaceDefinitionsRisk: When selected, current points omitted from the file will be deleted and may have their fact values cleared.
collectionFactsValueImportResult: Updated {updated} fact values and skipped {skipped} stale undefined points.
collectionFactsFileInvalid: The file format is invalid. Use the approved JSON/XLSX shape and one declared worksheet.
collectionFactsFileSourceInvalid: The file must contain one sourceKey that matches the currently loaded contract.
collectionFactsFileVersionInvalid: The file contractVersion does not match the current contract.
collectionFactsFileNamesInvalid: The file has duplicate fact names.
collectionFactsFileNoCurrentNames: No imported point exists in the current definition, so nothing was written.
apiMaterialsHint: Load every standard HTTP operation from the current Backend openapi.json. Every operation can be selected; materials with resolved parameters can map directly, while unresolved materials can be loaded and completed later. Checkboxes are drafts until Save selection synchronizes them to the database.
apiMaterialsReasonBodySchema: JSON request body schema is unsupported
apiMaterialsReasonDuplicateParameter: Contains duplicate parameters at one level
apiMaterialsReasonPathParameterMismatch: Path placeholders do not match parameters
apiMaterialsEmpty: Load the current Backend OpenAPI to show all standard HTTP operations.
apiMaterialsFilterNoMatches: No operations match the current filters.
apiMaterialsMissingWarning: {count} selected materials no longer exist in the current OpenAPI. Saving removes their selection but keeps existing Target APIs.
apiMaterialsSaveResult: Selection saved: {created} created, {updated} updated, {unchanged} unchanged, {removed} removed.
apiMaterialsOperationFailed: The API Material operation did not complete. Failed or empty catalogs cannot save removals.
targetApiConfigurationHint: Load Target APIs from selected materials or manually maintain current-Backend relative paths and location-aware parameters. This page saves configuration and sends no request.
targetApiEmpty: No Target API configuration has been saved.
targetApiIdempotencyHelp: Enable this only when repeated delivery of the same business request does not produce duplicate business results. This records a downstream capability and does not add deduplication. Material loading deduplication and target business idempotency are separate concepts.
targetApiSaved: Target API configuration was saved by the Backend.
targetApiInUse: This Target API is referenced by a mapping configuration and cannot be deleted.
targetApiOperationFailed: The Target API configuration operation did not complete. Check the saved Backend connection and configuration content.
targetApiMaterialLoadResult: Material load complete: {created} created, {skipped} skipped, {requiresConfiguration} need parameter completion.
targetApiMaterialDialogHint: Only selected OpenAPI materials saved in the database appear here. Resolved materials bring in their parameters directly; unresolved materials can also be loaded and completed in Target API Configuration. Already loaded entries cannot be selected again.
targetApiMaterialEmpty: No selected API Materials exist. Load OpenAPI and save a selection on the API Materials page first.
targetApiDeleteConfirm: Delete Target API “{name}”? The Backend will reject this if a mapping references it.
targetApiRemoveSelectedConfirm: Delete the {count} selected Target APIs? The whole deletion is blocked if any selected API is referenced by a mapping configuration.
mappingBatchOperationsHint: Imports are validated and previewed by the Backend before an explicit apply. In Tauri, templates and exports open the system Save As dialog; browsers use a download fallback.
mappingBatchOperationFailed: The batch operation did not complete. Check the file structure, Backend connection, and configuration references.
mappingBatchPreviewErrors: The preview contains errors. This batch cannot be applied and no configuration will be written.
mappingValueRulesHint: Maintain reusable finite legal-value presets. Saved facts can be loaded as independent preset drafts; this never reads or updates fact values.
mappingValueRuleRemoveDraftConfirm: Remove the {count} selected local drafts? These drafts have not been saved to the Backend.
mappingValueRuleEmptyValuesHint: An empty array can be saved as a pending preset; it is not selectable from Mapping Configurations.
mappingValueRulesEmpty: No Mapping Value Rule has been saved.
mappingValueRuleSaved: The Mapping Value Rule was saved by the Backend.
mappingValueRuleInUse: This Mapping Value Rule is referenced by a mapping configuration and cannot be deleted.
mappingValueRuleDeleteConfirm: Delete Mapping Value Rule “{name}”? The Backend will reject this if a mapping references it.
mappingValueRuleOperationFailed: The Mapping Value Rule operation did not complete. Check the Backend connection and input.
mappingConfigurationsHint: Choose a source key and fact for each enabled Target API parameter, or enter a fixed value. Without a value rule, the fact value is used directly; the preview stays local and never sends a target business POST.
mappingConfigurationsEmpty: No mapping configuration has been saved.
mappingConfigurationSaved: The mapping configuration was saved by the Backend.
mappingConfigurationOperationFailed: The mapping configuration operation did not complete. Check facts, Target API, value rules, and input types.
mappingConfigurationFactMissing: Fact is not selected or loaded
mappingConfigurationValueInvalid: Constant does not match the parameter data type
mappingConfigurationRuleRejected: Constant does not match the value rule
mappingConfigurationRuleDeferred: Dynamic fact values are checked at later execution
mappingConfigurationPreviewHint: This preview never calls the Target API; saving only writes Backend configuration.
mappingManualRunConfirm: Run saved Mapping “{mappingName}” ({mappingKey}) against Target API “{targetName}” ({targetApiKey}): {method} {path}. This sends a real request and may create or update target business data. Continue?
mappingManualRunInProgress: Manual run is in progress; this saved row is locked
mappingManualRunPreflightRejected: Preflight rejected; no Target request was sent
mappingManualRunSucceeded: This request received a successful response
mappingManualRunFailed: This request received a non-success response
mappingManualRunAmbiguous: Request outcome is ambiguous; no automatic retry occurred
mappingManualRunStale: Configuration changed; this result is stale
collectionSimulationHint: Load saved rules for the current sourceKey, configure simulation write values and independent intervals, then save. Datetime sequence values must be timezone-aware RFC 3339 (for example 2026-08-26T15:30:00.000Z or +08:00). Simulation updates only existing collection_facts rows.
simulationAutoStartHint: Starts Simulation for its saved sourceKey only after this SMA app open; this is not OS boot startup.
singleFactProducerWarning: Coordinate external writers for the same facts before starting. SMA does not claim, prioritize, or automatically arbitrate external writers.
simulationWriteCurrentTime: Write the current time on every interval
simulationWriteCurrentTimeHint: The Runtime obtains the time at this row's interval. System timezone means the SMA Runtime host, not the browser, Backend, or SQL Server.
simulationDisabledHint: An empty array without current time disables a point
simulationSettingsUnsaved: Simulation settings have unsaved changes; save before starting.
simulationNoPoints: The current sourceKey has no saved facts. Load or apply a fact definition first.

simulationValidation.SIMULATION_POINT_INTERVAL_INVALID: Enter an integer interval from 20 to 86400000 ms.
simulationValidation.SIMULATION_POINT_VALUES_ARRAY_REQUIRED: The value must be a JSON array.
simulationValidation.SIMULATION_POINT_CURRENT_TIME_INVALID: Writing the current time is available only for datetime points.
simulationValidation.SIMULATION_POINT_CURRENT_TIME_MODE_INVAL: Choose UTC, system timezone, or custom timezone.
simulationValidation.SIMULATION_POINT_CUSTOM_TIME_ZONE_REQUIR: A custom timezone requires an IANA name, for example Asia/Shanghai.
simulationValidation.SIMULATION_POINT_VALUE_TYPE_INVALID: One or more values do not match the point data type.

apiFirstMappingRuntimeHint: Locks enabled Mapping and Target API configuration at start. Each cycle freshly reads that Mapping’s bound facts and sends a POST, including unchanged values, then waits its saved execution interval. Failed reads do not send old values; reads resume next cycle.
apiFirstMappingRuntimeSafety: A failed Target request or uncertain outcome blocks only the current Mapping, without automatic replay.
mappingRuntimeAutoStartHint: Starts the API-first Mapping Runtime only after this SMA app opens; this is not OS boot startup.
targetApiPartIdentityHint: Part targets require both device and part path bindings. Preserve the OpenAPI names (currently path:device_id and path:part_id, representing deviceId and partId); never infer body.
targetApiPartUnionHint: Card statusValueNN union types cannot currently be imported automatically. Define the target manually with explicit device/part path parameters, a card body template and typed scalar bindings, then inspect the request preview.
